Commentary.Commentary: Right then! The series is under the belt but New Zealand will not relax as they will look for a clean sweep. The third and final ODI will be played on 4th April at 6.30 am IST (1 am GMT). But as you all know our build-up will begin in advance. Do join us for that. Cheers!

Tom Latham, the skipper of New Zealand is also the Player of the Match. He says that it's nice to cap it off with a win like that and It was nice to bat through the innings and set a good score. Adds that they needed to bat 50 overs, and he managed to have a couple of partnerships, with Doug Bracewell and Colin de Grandhomme. Mentions that they bowled well though. Says that they were in a bit of trouble today, but managed to pull things towards the end of the overs. States that the spinners bowled beautifully, Sodhi in the first 20 overs and Michael Bracewell towards the end. Concludes by saying that they can hopefully finish on a high note.

Pieter Seelaar, the skipper of Netherlands, says that they executed their plans, but the wicket was tacky, and New Zealand were fantastic. Says that they are world-class players and Latham played an absolute captain's knock. Adds that the first two wickets fell quickly, but Vikram and Bas de Leede got them to a good position, but Sodhi came in and changed everything. Informs that the mistake with three fielders inside the ring cost them. Adds that they were good at the start, but Tom just took the game away from them. Informs that they had New Zealand on the ropes, but they weren't quite up to the mark.
Stay tuned for the presentation...

Earlier in the day, if not for Latham's innings, New Zealand would have been dismissed under 150 but the birthday boy presented himself a gift with a match-winning century and in the end, it was enough for New Zealand to win the series.

New Zealand bowlers were consistent with their line and length throughout and all the bowlers that Latham used were rewarded with a wicket at least. They had their noses upfront almost throughout the game. The stand between Vikramjit Singh and Bas de Leede was building but Colin de Grandhomme took the wicket of the former and since then, there was not much sweat thrown. The middle phase was controlled brilliantly by Ish Sodhi and Michael Bracewell who took 5 wickets together. In the end, it was a complete performance from New Zealand.

Netherlands were in early trouble as both the openers fell very early. It was then the partnership of Vikramjit Singh and Bas de Leede that helped Netherlands get back on track but once Singh fell, the gates opened and wickets started tumbling. Pieter Seelaar and Michael Rippon were the only hopes but they too perished very cheaply and ultimately, they were beaten comprehensively by the host.

New Zealand win the three-match ODI series as they go 2-0 up. They had the upper hand coming into the series and they lived up to the expectation. Netherlands showed a good fight, but they were beaten by some classic bowling performance from the Kiwis.

OUT! CAUGHT! Ish Sodhi finishes things off! He grabs the last wicket and New Zealand have clinched the series! A shorter ball, spinning away sharply, outside off. Brandon Glover looks to pull this, but he decides against it at the end and leaves his bat hanging. The ball goes off his toe end towards first slip. Ross Taylor there grabs it safely. New Zealand win by 118 runs!
Commentary.Howout: c Ross Taylor b Ish Sodhi

Commentary.Commentary: Ish Sodhi is back on.

DROPPED! A very tough chance though! Another fuller ball, around middle. Brandon Glover lifts it over the bowler's head. Blair Tickner from mid off runs across to his right, dives, and gets to the ball but fails to grab it. It would have been a spectacular catch! Single taken!
Fuller ball, outside off. Brandon Glover defends it out towards cover.
Shorter ball this time, spinning in, around middle. Fred Klaassen swivels and pulls it towards deep square leg for a single.
FOUR! Up and over! Slower through the air, full, around off. Fred Klaassen lifts it over mid off for a boundary.
Another loopy delivery, full, around middle. Brandon Glover pushes it with the inner half of his bat towards square leg for a single.
Tosses it up, full, around off. Fred Klaassen drives it towards cover for a single.
Shorter ball, around middle and leg. Brandon Glover ducks underneath it.
On a length, outside off, shaping away. Brandon Glover looks to drive but he misses.
Drinks! It's been an exceptional bowling performance from New Zealand. They are just one wicket away now from winning the game and clinching the series.
OUT! TIMBER! This is full and on middle, very full and lack pace as well. Dutt is too late as he looks to dig it out and the ball sneaks under his bat to rattle the stumps.
Fuller and angling on the pads. Dutt misses his flick and gets hit on the pads. An appeal but that was clearly going down.
Wide! Short ball from wide of the crease and slanting on middle. Dutt evades it.
Fuller and on the pads, tucked to mid-wicket.
A pacy short ball, on off. Dutt sways away from it. The keeper does well to collect the ball.
Flatter and on off. Klaassen plays with the spin to mid-wicket.
Slightly short and on middle. Klaassen flicks it to square leg.
On middle, drilled down to long on for a single.
FOUR! Tossed up, full and outside off. Dutt prods to defend but gets a thick outside edge past first slip for a boundary.
Michael Bracewell keeps getting the turn, outside off. Dutt swings across but gets an inside edge to square leg for a single.
Fuller, outside off, spinning back in. Dutt keeps it out.
Length ball, outside off. Klaassen guides it to point.
Thihs is full and outside off. Klaassen misses his drive.
Length ball, outside off. Klaassen cuts it late and past gully for a couple of runs.
On a length, on off. Blocked out.
Just short of Sodhi! This is short and outside off. Dutt tries to upper cut it towards third man where Ish Sodhi runs forward and dives low but looked like it did not carry to him. A single.
Short of a length, angling on middle. Dutt blocks it out to mid on.
Fred Klaassen walks out.

OUT! EDGED AND TAKEN! Michael Bracewell gets his third wicket in his third over! Take a bow, Michael Bracewell! What a spell this turning out to be! Another beautiful delivery by Michael Bracewell! A loopy delivery, outside off, full in length. Logan van Beek presses forward and looks to defend this, but the ball goes off the outside edge towards first slip. Ross Taylor there juggles and holds on to it. Netherlands have lost their eighth wicket.
Commentary.Howout: c Ross Taylor b Michael Bracewell

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Nicely done! Outside off, flatter ball, fullish delivery. Logan van Beek slices it past point for a boundary.
Fuller, around middle. Logan van Beek blocks it out off the back foot.
Tosses it up, outside off, full in length. Logan van Beek presses forward and defends it out.
Full again, slower through the air, outside off. Logan van Beek lunges forward and blocks it out.
Loopy delivery, full, outside off. Logan van Beek defends it out.
Tad fuller, outside off. Aryan Dutt leans and defends it out.
Angling in on the pads, on a length. Aryan Dutt misses his flick and gets rapped on his pads.
Back of a length, around middle and off. Aryan Dutt defends it out off the back foot.
Length, around middle. Aryan Dutt blocks it out towards mid-wicket.
Another length delivery, outside off. Logan van Beek guides it towards third man. Single taken!
On a length, around middle and off. Logan van Beek defends it out.
Fuller ball, tosses it up full. Aryan Dutt leans and drives it past cover for a brace.
Loopy delivery, outside off, fuller in length. Aryan Dutt looks to defend but he misses and gets hit on the pads.
fuller ball, around middle. Aryan Dutt blocks it out.
Aryan Dutt is the new batter in.

OUT! STUMPED! Michael Bracewell, you beauty! Another ripper by him! What a peach of a delivery. He grabs his second wicket and Netherlands lose their 7th now. A loopy ball, full, outside off. This one lands outside off and turns back in sharply once again. Michael Rippon steps down the pitch and looks to drive this but he misses. The ball zips past his inside edge and goes to Tom Latham behind the stumps. He collects the ball and whips the bails off.
Commentary.Howout: st Tom Latham b Michael Bracewell

Commentary.Commentary: Shortish ball, around middle. Logan van Beek taps it towards square leg and scampers through to the other end. The fielder there grabs the ball quickly and throws it to Michael Bracewell, who fails to grab the ball. Single taken!
Quicker one, spinning in, around middle. Logan van Beek blocks it out off the back foot.
Outside off, on a length. Michael Rippon taps it towards point.
Good-length delivery, around middle and leg. Logan van Beek tucks it towards square leg for a single.
Pitches it up this time, around middle. Logan van Beek blocks it out.
Another length delivery, outside off. Michael Rippon opens the face of his bat and guides it towards third man for a single.
Shorter ball, around the leg pole. Michael Rippon leaves it alone.
Nipping in, on a length, around middle. Michael Rippon blocks it out toward mid on.
Slower through the air, full, around the pads. Logan van Beek taps it toward square leg.
Outside off, shorter ball. Logan van Beek blocks it toward cover.
Loopy delivery, full, around middle. Logan van Beek blocks it out.
Logan van Beek comes in now.

OUT! CLEANED HIM UP! Michael Bracewell strikes in his first over! An absolute ripper by him. An off spinner's delight! Michael Bracewell tosses it up, full in length. This one lands outside off and turns back in sharply. Pieter Seelaar leans to block this but he misses and the ball sneaks past his inside edge and goes on to knock the off pole. Netherlands have lost their sixth wicket now!
Well bowled! A fuller ball, loopy delivery, turns back in. Pieter Seelaar leans to drive but he gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Michael Bracewell begins with a full toss, around middle. Michael Rippon knocks it down to long on for a single.
Michael Bracewell comes into the attack.
Short and on middle. Seelaar ducks under it.
Short of a length, outside off, it nips away after landing. Seelaar flashes his blade at it and misses.
On a length, on off. Seelaar taps it to covers.
This one just keeps coming with the angle, on a length and on middle. Seelaar is surprised and withdraws his bat on time. The ball bounces over the stumps.
Length ball, slanting on middle. Seelaar nudges it to mid-wicket.
Fuller ball, straying around off. Seelaar keeps it out on the off side.
Doug Bracewell (4-1-21-1) comes back into the attack.
Length and outside off. Defended out.
Wide! Full ball, down the leg side. Rippon misses his flick.
Angles it on the pads, flicked to deep square leg for a single.
Outside off. Rippon steers it to third man for a single.
Length and on off, pushed through covers for a single.

DROPPED AND SIX! Should have been taken! Short ball, angling on off. Seelaar upper cuts it, not in full control but still goes with his shot. Doug Bracewell at third man is in action as he stands near to the ropes and takes it above his head but fails to hold it and it goes over for a biggie.
Length and on middle, at 130.8 kph. Blocked out.
Shorter and outside off, pushed to covers.
FOUR! Confident shot! Angles a full ball, on middle. Rippon steps across and sweeps it hard to deep square leg.
Flatter, outside off and a sharp leg breaker. Rippon watchfully leaves it.
Around off. Rippon takes a big stride forward to block it.
Tossed up, full and was the googly. Seelaar tucks it to square leg and runs across to complete the single.
Pieter Seelaar the skipper of Netherlands walks out to bat now.

OUT! TAKEN! Bas de Leede, the set batter goes now and Netherlands are in deep, deep trouble. This is a touch short and outside off, it lands and spins back in, and stays low as well. Bas de Leede pushes it aerially and straight in the hands of Michael Bracewell at mid-wicket. All the pressure from Sodhi and he gets the reward.
Commentary.Howout: c Michael Bracewell b Ish Sodhi

Commentary.Commentary: Fuller and outside off, driven straight to covers.
Superb bowling! Short of a length, outside off, in that channel. Rippon has a poke at it but misses.
Short of a length, on off. Rippon drops it to backward point.
Outside off, cut away to deep point for a single.
A length ball, outside off. de Leede looks to push on the front foot but misses it.
Length ball, on off. de Leede punches it to cover.
Touch short and on off. Rippon shuffles across and tucks it to mid-wicket.
A googly, outside off. Rippon steps across and down to keep it out.
A loopy ball, outside off. de Leede lunges and strokes it to deep cover for a single.
Tossed up, on off, de Leede knocks it to covers.
Very full and outside  off. Rippon reaches to the pitch of the ball as he swipes this one to deep square leg.
Fuller and outside off. de Leede leans and drives it through covers for a single. 100 up for Netherlands.
FOUR! Another top shot! A fuller ball this time, outside off. Michael Rippon presses forward and drives it past cover for a boundary. 10 runs off the over, more importantly, a wicket off it!
SIX! Wow, what a shot! A shorter ball, outside off. Michael Rippon hops and upper cuts it towards third man all the way for a biggie! He gets off the mark in style!
Another length delivery, outside off. Michael Rippon pushes it towards cover.
On a length, angling in, around middle and leg. Michael Rippon blocks it out.
Michael Rippon walks out to the middle.

OUT! CAUGHT! Blair Tickner comes back into the attack and strikes! Netherlands have lost their fourth wicket as Scott Edwards departs for a timid score. Blair Tickner drops it short, around middle and off. Scott Edwards pulls it but the ball goes off the top edge, towards Henry Nicholls at deep square leg takes an easy catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Henry Nicholls b Blair Tickner

Commentary.Commentary: Beaten! On a length, outside off. Scott Edwards leans to drive and gets beaten on the outside edge. Tom Latham appeals for caught behind, but the umpire is not interested.
Blair Tickner is back into the attack.
Well bowled! Outside off, fuller ball, a leg spinner. Bas de Leede leans to defend but he misses.
Sharp turn! This one lands on a fuller length, around middle and spins away sharply, and goes outside off. Bas de Leede hangs back to defend this but he gets beaten.
Shortish ball, around off. Bas de Leede pushes it back to Sodhi off the back foot.
Another loopy ball, around off, full in length. Bas de Leede lunges forward and blocks it out.
Tosses it up, full, around middle and off. Bas de Leede pushes it back to the bowler.
Slower through the air, very full, around middle. Scott Edwards eases it down to long on for a single.
Beaten! An off-cutter, on a length, outside off. Bas de Leede looks to push this away but he misses.
Tad fuller now, outside off. Scott Edwards leans to drive, but the ball goes off the outside edge towards third man for a single.
Full on this occasion, around middle. Bas de Leede knocks it towards long on. Single taken!
Good-length delivery, outside off. Scott Edwards steers it down the third man for a single.
Another length delivery, outside off. Scott Edwards leaves it alone.
A slower ball, angling in on the pads, on a length. Scott Edwards flicks it towards square leg for a brace.
A googly this time, around middle and leg. Bas de Leede misses his flick and gets rapped on the pads.
Tosses it up, full, around middle. Bas de Leede defends it out solidly.
Another leg break, outside off, fuller in length. Bas de Leede blocks it out off the back foot.
Loopy ball, full, around off. Scott Edwards sweeps it towards square leg for a single.
Another leg spinner, outside off, fuller ball. Bas de Leede pushes it towards cover for a single.
Outside off, spinning away, fuller ball. Bas de Leede leaves it alone.

Drinks! Finally, New Zealand get the breakthrough and they will look to build on it. Ish Sodhi has been brilliant and his spell will be very crucial for the Kiwis. Netherlands need a big partnership and de Leede will hope Scott Edwards will help him out.

OUT! CAUGHT! A much-needed wicket for New Zealand! Colin de Grandhomme strikes at the right time. Vikramjit Singh was looking solid, but he departs after a fine knock. A full toss ball, around middle. Vikramjit Singh smashes it towards long on, there was no timing on that shot and it goes straight to Ish Sodhi there who takes a simple catch. Netherlands are 3 down!
Commentary.Howout: c Ish Sodhi b Colin de Grandhomme

Commentary.Commentary: Fuller ball, around middle. Vikramjit Singh drives it towards mid on.
Another length delivery, slower ball, around middle. Bas de Leede works it away towards mid on for a single.
FOUR! Nicely done! Another length delivery, outside off. Bas de Leede guides it past point for a boundary.
Another length delivery, around middle. Bas de Leede blocks it out.
On a length, around middle. Bas de Leede blocks it out.
FOUR! Bamboozled! A flighted ball, angling on off. SIngh looks to drive but gets an inside edge, past the leg stump and behind the ground for a boundary.
Flatter and on off. Singh gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Sharp turn! A googly, fuller and outside off. Singh looks to push but misses. Latham clips the bails off but Singh had his back foot down.
Foated on off, pushed to long off for a single.
GIves flight to this one, fuller and outside off. de Leede looks to drive but gets an inside edge to square leg.
A googly, on a length and on the pads. de Leede does not pick it and leaves it alone for the ball to hit him on the pads.
Length, slower and on off. Singh pushes it to mid-wicket.
On middle. Blocked out.
Another slower ball, fuller and down the leg side. Singh sweeps it fine but the keeper has enough time to get on that side and stop it.
An off cutter, around off. Singh knocks it to point.
Slants it on the pads, this is flicked behind square on the leg side for a single.
Way outside off, pushed to deep cover for a couple of runs.
Very full and on the pads. Singh gets low to paddle it but misses. An appeal for LBW but was pitching outside leg. The ball rolls past the leg stump.
A leg breaker, around off. Singh punches it to mid off.
Full, flighted, on off, driven straight to mid off.
Tossed up, on middle. Singh prods to defend.
Fuller and on middle. de Leede leans and tucks it to square leg for a single.
A length ball, outside off, spins away. de Leede tries to chase this one but leaves very late.
Time for some spin! Ish Sodhi comes into the attack.
On middle. on a length. Kept out.
Around off, pushed through covers for a single.
On a length, on middle. A length ball, outside off. de Leede looks to cut it but gets a thick outside edge to third man. de Leede flicks it to deep square leg and comes back for the second run.

FOUR! A length ball, outside off. de Leede looks to cut it but gets a thick outside edge to third man. Doug Bracewell runs to his left and slides. He flicks back but the ball rolls back and while he attempts the second time, his leg touches the ropes.
Outside off, on a  length, pushed to mid off.
A length ball, swinging a touch away, outside off. de Leede defends it out.
Colin de Grandhomme comes into the attack.
FOUR! Two in a row! Shorter and on middle. Singh pulls it to deep mid-wicket for another boundary.
FOUR! Crunched! Fuller ball, outside off. Singh smashes it straight down the ground, well past mid off for a boundary.
Wide! Length ball way down the leg side. Singh fails to pull it.
Short of a length, swinging on middle. Singh looks to block it out but misses.
This time Singh tries to hook this one away but fails to do it.
This is short and on middle. Singh ducks under it.
Length and on off. Singh taps it to point.
Powerplay 2 time! Now, 4 fielders will be allowed outside the circle till the 40th over.
Short in length, around middle. Bas de Leede defends it solidly from within the crease.
Fuller ball, outside off. Bas de Leede drives it firmly but straight to the fielder at cover.
Swinging in this time, outside off, on a length. Bas de Leede leaves it alone.
Back of a length, angling in around off. Bas de Leede blocks it out off the back foot.
FOUR! Boundaries have started to flow for Netherlands! This one lands on a length, width on offer this time. Bas de Leede cuts it past point for a boundary. Perfectly placed!
Tad shorter now, around middle. Bas de Leede blocks it out off the back foot.
Wide! Down the leg side, on a length. Bas de Leede misses his flick. Wide called!
Shortish ball, around middle and leg. Vikramjit Singh ducks under it. 8 runs off Blair Tickner's first over!
On a length, around off. Vikramjit Singh taps it towards point.
FOUR! This is a much better shot by Vikramjit Singh! A shorter ball this time, outside off. Vikramjit Singh hangs back and slaps this over point for another cracking boundary.
FOUR! Crunched! A fuller ball now, outside off. Vikramjit Singh gets down on his knee and drives it powerfully over point for a boundary.
Another good-length, swinging in, around middle. Vikramjit Singh tries to block this but he gets an inside edge back onto his pads.
Blair Tickner starts off with a length, ball, swinging in, outside off, at around 136 clicks. Vikramjit Singh pushes it towards point off the back foot.
Blair Tickner is into the attack.
Back of a length around middle. Bas de Leede defends it out.
FOUR LEG BYES! On a length, sliding down leg. Bas de Leede looks to tuck this away, but he misses. The ball brushes off his thigh pads and goes towards fine leg for a boundary!
FOUR! Top shot! Shorter ball, width on offer this time. Bas de Leede hangs back and slashes it over point for a boundary.
Kyle Jamieson drops it short again, shaping away, outside off. Bas de Leede leaves it alone.
Shorter ball again, around middle. Bas de Leede blocks it out off the back foot.
Back of a length, outside off. Bas de Leede defends it towards point.
Tad fuller, outside off. Vikramjit Singh pushes it towards mid off.
On a length, around middle. Vikramjit Singh defends it out.
FOUR! Lovely shot! Outside off, fuller ball. Vikramjit Singh leans and drives it past cover for a boundary.
Fuller ball, angling in, around middle. Vikramjit Singh pushes it past mid-wicket for a brace.

DROPPED AND FOUR! A tough chance though! Shorter ball, around off. Vikramjit Singh leans back and upper cuts it towards third man. Ish Sodhi runs forward, and dives, but he manages to get only his fingers on the ball. The ball rolls behind him towards the ropes. Boundary!
Around off, on a length. Vikramjit Singh blocks it out.
Shortish ball, outside off. Vikramjit Singh cuts it over the fielder at gully for a single. He gets off the mark on his 19th delivery!
Good-length delivery, around middle and leg. Vikramjit Singh blocks it out.
On a length, swinging in sharply, outside off. Bas de Leede dabs it towards third man for a single.
Back of a length, outside off, shaping away. Bas de Leede leaves it alone.
On a length, swinging in, around middle and leg. Bas de Leede tucks it towards square leg.
A shorter ball, angling in, around middle. Bas de Leede defends it out.
Length and on middle. Singh pushes it uppishly and to mid on.
Five wides! Too short and on middle. Singh leaves it alone and it goes comfortably over the keeper to find the fence.
Around off, pushed to covers.
Wide! Length ball, down the leg side. Singh misses his tuck.
Play halted! Vikramjit Singh has been hit on his helmet. The physio is out there to check on him. A mandatory concussion will be conducted. He seems fine and we are good to go!
Short ball, on middle. Singh looks to pull but misses it and gets hit on the helmet. He looks fine but still the concussion protocol will follow.
On the pads, bunted to square leg.
Touch short and angling on the hips. Singh is late as he looks to nudge it away.
Length ball, around off. de Leede steps forward and tucks it to mid-wicket for a quick single.
An outswinger now, away from the left-hander. Singh reads well to defend it out.
Short of a length and outside off. Blocked out.
Wide! Again down the leg side. Singh fails to whip it away.

Beauty! A length ball, angling around off and this one holds its line. Singh has no clue about this ripper and misses his defense. The ball goes over the off pole and Singh is just standing there fragile.
Wide! Down the leg side, Singh misses his flick.
On a length, around middle and nips back in with some extra bounce. Singh looks to flick but misses and gets hit high on the pads.
Length ball, on off. Singh dead bats it.
Fuller ball, outside off. de Leede drives it away from the body and gets a thick outside edge through the gully region for a single.
Touch short and on off. Singh blocks it out. A maiden over.
Length and outside off Singh cuts it but finds Henry Nicholls at point.
Length and on middle. Singh keeps it out on the leg side.
Length and on off. Defended out solidly.

On a length and on middle, Singh pushes it to cover.
A huge appeal for LBW but not given. Might be going down the leg side. An inswinger, fuller and around middle. de Leede looks to defend but misses and gets hit on the front pad.
Outside off. Left alone by de Leede
Length ball, outside off, nips away a touch. de Leede shoulders arms to it.
Short in length and outside off, extra bounce and pace. de Leede is squared up as he looks to defend.
FOUR! A fuller ball, way outside off. Bas de Leede drives it through covers for a boundary. Good timing on it.

OUT! EDGE AND GONE! Second over of the innings and both the openers are gone! Short of a length, around off, Jamieson generates that extra pace there. Max O'Dowd looks to defend but it takes the outside edge and goes to first slip but Martin Guptill from second slip takes in front of the first slip fielder, juggles a bit but does well to keep near his chest. New Zealand are off to a superb start.
Commentary.Howout: c Martin Guptill b Kyle Jamieson

Commentary.Commentary: Kyle Jamieson will bowl from the other end.
Length and on off. Singh defends it out.
Vikramjit Singh comes to bat at number 3.

OUT! CAUGHT AND BOWLED! Excellent start for New Zealand! A length ball, on middle. Myburgh looks to work it away on the leg side but the steep bounce takes the top edge and lobs towards cover. A fielder runs across but Bracewell shouts loud and clear 'MINE' to take the catch. Just the start the host wanted.
Length ball, on off. Myburgh punches off the back foot to covers.
On the pads, tucked to mid-wicket.
FOUR! Slashed hard! A length ball, width on offer and Myburgh cuts it past point for a boundary.
Lovely delivery to start the proceedings! A length ball, angling across. Myburgh looks to defend but gets beaten on the outside edge.
